en.name: RentCar
en.summary: A fleet management and online booking platform for a Moroccan car rental operator. It became DriveDesk, the product we now ship and run.
en.outcome: -60% daily admin time. Three vendor systems replaced by one. 99.9% uptime over 14 months.
